title: Three Years and One Short Staff
subtitle: 责任担当 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 责任担当（做人与做事·责任与担当）
meta: 主题语境：责任担当（做人与做事·责任与担当）　|　核心词汇：responsibility　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 responsibility 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1974 the elder ① took the responsibility that no youth in the village would have recorded, and he said the taking was the whole of the year. The ② responsibility, meaning the duty itself and not the staff, ran three years and stayed unrecorded in the book; responsibility, he said, is the only thing in a village that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ bit of responsibility in that village had the same short staff beside it, and the ④ responsibility at the far gate, meaning the hope they kept for the children to keep and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Responsibility, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the elder said the recording is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the responsibility was the whole of the matter, meaning the burden and not the duty. The ⑥ responsibility, meaning the burden and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; responsibility, he said, is either something you take or the only word that means both duty and a burden. He said the burden is the part they remember.

By 1979 the ⑦ responsibility had become a line in a memoir, and the memoir had become an argument about the short staff. The ⑧ responsibility of the whole thing, the elder wrote in November, was one village and three years of recording; responsibility, he said, is either the hope at the far gate or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ responsibility I remember is the responsibility recorded in the memoir, which closed in 1981 and is still recorded as the quietest in the village. ⑩ Responsibility, my mother said in 1983, is the only thing that improves by being recorded; all responsibility, she said, is a burden that has agreed to look like duty. She said the burden was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 责任（指村子里每一点旁边的那一点）
B. n. 责任（指那份责任本身，与短短的拐杖相对）
C. 固定搭配：take the responsibility 担起这一份责任
D. n. 责任（指留给孩子们守着的那一个）
E. n. 责任之事（抽象总称，指一处村子的责任之事）
F. n. 责任（指回忆录里写到、被记载的那一份）
G. n. 责任、担子（指一件事里人人都想却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 担子（抽象总称，指人人都想却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: took the responsibility that no youth in the village would have recorded
The responsibility, meaning the duty itself and not the staff
Every bit of responsibility in that village
the responsibility at the far gate
the responsibility was the whole of the matter

answers.why: take the responsibility 意为“担起这一份责任”，1974 年那位长者把村子里没有一位后生肯记载的一份责任做了一遍。
responsibility 意为“责任”，指那份责任本身而不是短短的拐杖，它经过了三个年头而在簿子上没有被记载。
responsibility 意为“责任”，指村子里每一点旁边的那一点，每一点旁边都有同一根短短的拐杖。
responsibility 意为“责任”，指最远那道村口的留给孩子们守着的那一个，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
responsibility 意为“责任、担子”，指一件事里人人都想却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份担子就是那件事的全部。
responsibility 意为“担子”，指人人都想却无人提起的那样东西而不是那份责任，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
responsibility 意为“责任”，指回忆录里写到、被记载的那一份，到 1979 年这一份成了回忆录里的一行。
responsibility 意为“责任之事”，长者十一月写道，整件事的责任之事是一处村子和三个年头的记载。
responsibility 意为“责任”，我记得的是回忆录里记载过的那一份，1981 年想通了，至今仍被说成村子里最安静的一份。
responsibility 为抽象总称，母亲 1983 年说，责任是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的责任。
